target.title: fix(telegram): Mini App hangs on Opening dashboard when auth never responds
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Telegram Mini App dashboard bootstrap could hang forever on **"Opening dashboard..."** when the same-origin `auth` fetch never returned (stalled upstream / hung TCP). The generated page had no request deadline, so `.catch(showExpired)` never ran.

## Why This Change Was Made

Bound the Mini App-owned `auth` fetch with a **15s** hang floor using an `AbortController` + `setTimeout` / `clearTimeout` (not `AbortSignal.timeout`), so older Telegram WebViews that lack the static timeout API still open the dashboard and still recover into the existing expired/retry status.

- Healthy auth clears the timer after settle (no late abort race)
- Stalled auth aborts and hits the existing `.catch(showExpired)` path
- No new config/env surface; auth validation / token minting unchanged

## User Impact

**Before:** A hung Mini App `auth` request left the WebView on “Opening dashboard...” indefinitely.

**After:** After 15s the page shows “This link expired. Reopen the dashboard from your bot chat.” so the user can retry from the bot chat. Clients without `AbortSignal.timeout` are not broken by a synchronous throw before `fetch`.

## Evidence

- Changed: `extensions/telegram/src/miniapp/page.ts`
- Regressions: `page.test.ts`, `page.auth-timeout.test.ts`, `routes.test.ts`

### Unit + route + hung-socket regression

```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/telegram/src/miniapp/page.auth-timeout.test.ts extensions/telegram/src/miniapp/page.test.ts extensions/telegram/src/miniapp/routes.test.ts --reporter=verbose
```

```text
 ✓ |extension-telegram| ... > embeds AbortController timer cancellation in the production bootstrap page 43ms
 ✓ |extension-telegram| ... > aborts a hung same-origin auth fetch and shows the expired status 15016ms
 ✓ |extension-telegram| ... > serves the page without resolving published URLs
 ✓ |extension-telegram| ... > bounds the auth fetch with AbortController and a cleared timer
 Test Files  3 passed (3)
      Tests  11 passed (11)
[test] passed 1 Vitest shard in 20.36s
```

## Real behavior proof

- **Behavior or issue addressed:** Hung Mini App `auth` fetches no longer leave “Opening dashboard...” forever; they abort via AbortController timer and show the expired/retry status.
- **Canonical reachability path:** `renderTelegramMiniAppPage()` → generated HTML `AbortController` + 15s timer → `fetch("auth", { signal })` → `.catch(showExpired)`; served by `registerTelegramMiniAppRoutes` GET `/__openclaw_tg_miniapp/`.
- **Boundary crossed:** Telegram Mini App bootstrap HTML only; auth route validation/token minting unchanged.
- **Shared helper / provider constraint check:** Uses platform `AbortController` / `setTimeout` / `clearTimeout` (WebView-compatible). Does not use `AbortSignal.timeout`.
- **Real environment tested:**
  1. Vitest against a real `node:http` hung `/auth` socket (mirrored page cancellation).
  2. **Chromium executing the production generated HTML** (Playwright): mock Telegram WebApp `initData`, hang `/auth`, observe status transition.
- **Exact steps or command run after this patch:**

```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/telegram/src/miniapp/page.auth-timeout.test.ts extensions/telegram/src/miniapp/page.test.ts extensions/telegram/src/miniapp/routes.test.ts --reporter=verbose
# Chromium executes renderTelegramMiniAppPage() HTML against hung /auth
```

- **Evidence after fix:**

```text
Unit/socket:
 ✓ embeds AbortController timer cancellation in the production bootstrap page
 ✓ aborts a hung same-origin auth fetch and shows the expired status 15016ms
 Test Files  3 passed (3)
      Tests  11 passed (11)

Chromium generated-page proof:
{
  "proof": "chromium-generated-miniapp-page-stalled-auth",
  "path": "renderTelegramMiniAppPage() HTML executed in Chromium",
  "openingStatus": "Opening dashboard...",
  "finalStatus": "This link expired. Reopen the dashboard from your bot chat.",
  "elapsedMs": 15095,
  "expectedFloorMs": 15000,
  "usesAbortSignalTimeout": false,
  "usesAbortControllerTimer": true,
  "leftOpeningDashboard": true,
  "reachedExpiredRetry": true
}
```

- **Observed result after fix:** Production HTML uses AbortController + cleared 15s timer (no `AbortSignal.timeout`). In Chromium, the served page starts on “Opening dashboard...”, then after ~15.1s shows the expired/retry message against a hung `/auth` socket.
- **What was not tested:** Live Telegram Desktop WebView recording against a real bot Mini App session (needs `@openclaw-mantis telegram desktop proof` / maintainer Mantis run).
- **Fix classification:** Root cause fix

- [x] AI-assisted (Cursor)
- [x] I understand what the code does
- [x] Change is focused and does not mix unrelated concerns
